content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the UCSL Office Assistant Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of UCSL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the UCSL Office Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the UCSL Office Assistant recruitment is 27 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Arts, Science, Commerce, Business Administration, or Computer Applications with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any work experience required for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of two years of post-qualification experience in office work, data entry, record maintenance, and report generation is essential for this role.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Office Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years as of 27 August 2026. Age relaxations are provided for OBC and SC categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Office Assistant post at Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited (UCSL).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Office Assistant role?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from ₹ 25,000/- in the first year to ₹ 27,150/- in the fifth year, with incremental increases each year of the contract.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the UCSL Office Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Written Tests, comprising an Objective Type Test and a Descriptive Type Test, followed by Certificate Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for the UCSL Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹ 300/- for General and OBC categories. SC, ST, and PwBD candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the contract for the Office Assistant position?
faq.answer: The Office Assistant position is offered on a five-year contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link can be found on the UCSL official website. Direct links are provided in the Important Links section of this article.
